title: Kunshin yarda da ku, hujja ta gaskiya da shirin kwanaki 90

say: Kunshin yarda da ku, hujja ta gaskiya, da shirin kwanaki 90.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na huɗu na Rijistar Kasuwanci da Biyayya a Najeriya.

Fakitin yarda da shi babban fayil ne mai tsari wanda ke riƙe da kowane takaddun da ke tabbatar da rajistar kasuwancin ku, na yau da kullun kuma an ba shi izinin siyar da abin da yake siyarwa. Ƙirƙiri babban fayil guda ɗaya, misali akan Google Drive.

panel.heading: Gina fakitin yarda da ku
items: Ƙirƙiri babban babban fayil guda ɗaya don kasuwancin
Ƙara manyan fayilolin sashe takwas masu lamba
Ajiye bayyanannun PDFs, kwanan wata da farko a cikin sunan
Ajiye bugu na mahimman takardu
Saka fihirisar shafi daya a gaba

say: A ciki, yi sassa takwas masu ƙididdigewa: rajista, dawowar shekara-shekara, haraji, banki, amincewar samfur, wurare, bayanai da mutane.

say: Bincika kowane takarda a sarari azaman PDF, kuma suna suna tare da kwanan wata da farko, don haka fayiloli su kasance cikin tsari.

say: Kuma tana da taƙaitaccen bayanin kowane wata na watanni 5 kacal cikin 8, don haka ta sake gina 3 da suka ɓace daga bayanan banki da rasit.
Guda hudu, kowanne yana da mataki na gaba. Ta fara gyara dawowar shekara da Tax ID, domin bankin ya nemi duka biyun.

say: Masu saye da masu ba da lamuni ba su kula da takardar shaidar kanta ba, da ƙari game da abin da ta ke nunawa: cewa kai na gaske ne, ana iya ganowa da kuma tsari.
Don haka kada ku yi iƙirarin abin da ba ku da shi.

panel.heading: Bayanin yarda da gaskiya
left: Nuna yarda ba ku da ita
Yi amfani da suna sabanin takaddun shaida
right: An ƙaddamar da aikace-aikacen NAFDAC, idan gaskiya ne
Sunan mai rijista akan kowane daftari

say: Cewa aikace-aikacen NAFDAC da aka gabatar, idan gaskiya ne, ya fi nuna yarda.

Misali, Funmi a Abeokuta ta amsa wani babban kanti a WhatsApp tare da wasu ‘yan jimloli na gaskiya game da rajistar CAC, dawowar ta na shekara, lambar NAFDAC da asusun kamfani, sannan ta makala takardu guda hudu kamar yadda aka bayyana sunayensu na PDF.

say: Kunshin ku yana riƙe da lambobin ID, sa hannu da bayanan banki. Yi amfani da kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi da tabbatarwa ta mataki biyu. Aika kawai daftarin aiki da aka nema, alama don manufarta.

panel.heading: Kare fakitin ku da kuɗin ku

cards.d: Ƙarfin kalmar sirri, tabbatarwa mataki biyu, babu takardu a tattaunawar rukuni.
Kuɗin aiki, BVN ɗinku da OTP, ko hanyar haɗin da ba na hukuma ba yana nufin tsayawa.
Bincika biyan kuɗin akan ribar gidan yanar gizon ku. Karanta kowane lokaci kafin sanya hannu.

say: Yi hankali sosai da tayin tallafi waɗanda ke neman kuɗin sarrafawa, BVN ɗinku da OTP, ko hanyar haɗin da ba ta cikin yankin hukuma. Shirye-shirye na gaske, kamar na SMEDAN, kada ku taɓa tambayar PIN ko OTP ɗin ku.

say: Kafin lamuni, ƙididdige biyan kuɗin kowane wata kuma duba shi daidai da ribar ku na wata. Karanta kowace kalma, kuma ku guje wa garantin sirri da ba ku fahimta sosai ba.

say: Yin biyayya yana zama mai sauƙi lokacin da aka tsara shi. Kowace rana, rikodin tallace-tallace da kashe kuɗi. A ƙarshen wata, zazzage bayanin ku, rubuta taƙaitaccen bayanin ku kuma sabunta fakitin.

Sau ɗaya a shekara: dawo da haraji

say: Sau ɗaya a shekara, yi fayil ɗin CAC ɗin ku na shekara-shekara da dawo da harajin ku.

say: A cikin kwanaki 31 zuwa 60, ta tabbatar da ID na Tax dinta, ta buɗe asusun kasuwanci, kuma ta motsa duk biyan kuɗin abokin ciniki a ciki.

say: A rana ta 90, ta sabunta fakitinta kuma ta saita masu tuni don dawowarta na shekara-shekara da shigar da haraji.
Idan aiki ya zame, ba shi sabon kwanan wata da dalili. Tsari na gaskiya wanda kashi 80 cikin 100 aka yi ya buge cikakken shirin da ke ɓoye giɓi.

say: Don tunawa. Ajiye fakiti ɗaya tare da sassa takwas. Juya kowane rata zuwa aiki. Kada ku taɓa nuna yarda ba ku da ita. Kar a taɓa biyan kuɗi ko raba OTP don tallafin da aka yi alkawari. Kuma sanya kowane fayil a kan kalandarku.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: fakiti ɗaya, sassa takwas, sunayen fayil kwanan wata
Binciken rata yana juya gibi zuwa ayyuka
Kada ku taɓa nuna yarda ba ku da ita
Kar a taɓa biyan kuɗi ko raba OTP don tallafi
Tunatarwa na kalanda don kowane fayil

say: Yanzu fara fakitin yarda, rubuta bayanin yarda, kuma saita kalandarku tare da shirin kwanaki 90. Raba shi tare da mutum ɗaya wanda zai duba ku a rana ta 45 da ranar 90.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Fara fakitin yarda da lissafin rata
Rubuta bayanin yarda da sautin ku
Saita kalandarku kuma rubuta shirin ku na kwanaki 90
